field.name: description
field.p: How to record money against the right fund, program, and function, and pull the board and IRS reports that build themselves from those answers.

record.field: Adding the non-profit chart of accounts

field.name: html_content
field.p: Before anything else, turn on Analytic Accounting under Settings › Accounting - this is what lets you tag a transaction with a fund, and everything below depends on it.

Then open Accounting › Configuration › Add Non-Profit Accounts. Leave Code Prefix blank unless the new account numbers collide with your existing chart, keep Skip Codes That Already Exist ticked, and click Add Accounts. It adds contribution, grant, special-events, in-kind, functional-expense, and net-asset accounts on top of what you already have - it never changes or removes anything.
Safe to re-run: if you're not sure whether it ran, run it again. Accounts that already exist are skipped.

field.name: html_content
field.p: Go to Settings › Accounting › Fund Accounting (Non-Profit). Under Net Assets Released accounts, click Detect from chart to fill the two clearing accounts the restriction-release entry uses, then pick a default Program and Function so you're not choosing them on every release.

Leave Require a Fund on income & expense off until you've entered your opening balances and any historical entries. Only then turn it on - once it's on, the system won't let anyone post an income or expense line that isn't 100% assigned to a fund, which is exactly what you want going forward, but would block your opening entries if it's on too soon.

record.field: The three questions every transaction answers

field.name: html_content
field.p: Fund - whose money is it? The starter funds are Unrestricted (most gifts), With Donor Restrictions - Purpose (must be spent on a specific thing), With Donor Restrictions - Time (can't be spent until a future period), and Perpetual / Endowment (the principal is never spent).
Program - which mission activity? A food pantry, an after-school club, a clinic day. Add one per real activity.
Function - what kind of work? The three Form 990 columns: Program Services, Management & General, Fundraising. Every expense is one of these.

You answer all three in the same place: the Analytic Distribution field on an invoice, bill, or journal-entry line. Set the fund to 100% (split across two if a gift is genuinely shared), then add the Program and Function the same way. That one field feeds every report later in this course.

field.name: html_content
field.p: Enter the bill as normal under Accounting › Vendors › Bills. On each expense line, set Analytic Distribution: the Fund it's paid from, the Program it serves, and the Function. Split a line if it's shared - e.g. 70% Program Services, 30% Management & General.

field.name: html_content
field.p: When a donor's purpose has been met or a time restriction has passed, you move that money from the restricted class to unrestricted - with the release wizard, not a hand-written journal entry. Open Accounting › Non-Profit › Restriction Releases › New, set Released From (the restricted fund) and Released To (normally Unrestricted), the amount and date, and click Post.

Posting creates one balanced journal entry between the two Net Assets Released accounts. On the Statement of Activities it shows as a reduction in the restricted column and an equal increase in the unrestricted column - zero to the bottom line. Made a mistake? Open the release and click Cancel to reverse it - never delete the entry by hand.
Check your work any time under Accounting › Non-Profit › Net-Asset Roll-Forward - opening balance, revenue, expense, releases in and out, and closing balance, per fund, for any date range.

field.name: html_content
field.p: Because every transaction already carries its fund, program, and function, the board reports come out without extra bookkeeping. Find them under Accounting › Reporting › MIS Reports - open the Current Year instance for the Statement of Activities (revenue by source, expense by function, change in net assets) and the Statement of Financial Position (assets, liabilities, and net assets split into with/without donor restrictions). Add fund-filtered periods to a report instance to show either one broken out by fund.

field.name: html_content
field.p: Accounting › Reporting › Non-Profit › Functional Expenses gives your 990 preparer a grid of every natural expense account against Program Services, Management & General, and Fundraising - built straight from the Function you set on every expense line.

record.field: A donor gives $5,000 that must be spent on the after-school club by June. Which Fund do you use?
A June deadline is a time condition, not a purpose one - though this gift also names the after-school club as its Program.
It doesn't need a fund, only a Program
Where do you set the Fund, Program, and Function on a transaction?
The Analytic Distribution field on the line
A separate spreadsheet you keep alongside Odoo
The journal used to post the entry
How do you move money from a restricted fund to unrestricted once the donor's condition is met?
Write a journal entry by hand between the two funds
Edit the original donation record's fund field
Delete and re-enter the original gift
